title: [SEP-4] Relay-side push registration sits outside the relay's budget and links channels to a devic
description: Review finding SEP-4: Relay-side push registration sits outside the relay's budget and links channels to a device (lens SEP). Location: spec/11-transport.md:160, 198-205, 253; vs ARCHITECTURE.md:161, 286-288. Fix: The budget gap is real. Q4 puts push "in the §5 budget by default", but §5 item 7 grants handles to push proxies only, and 11:160's claim "Neither party links a device to a DID or a channel" is false for the relay. The severity is lower than stated. A connected client already exposes its per-connection token set, and SEP-2's chain already links epochs. What the handle adds is cross-session, address-independent persistence of the cross-channel set. Minimum fix, which follows from Q4: amend §5 item 7 to cover the relay's pushHandle→channelToken set and correct 11:160. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: ARCHITECTURE.md §5 item 7 (lines ~171-176) declares relay learns pushHandle->channelToken set, users may disable push; spec/11-transport.md §11.7.1 "What the Relay learns" corrected
